label: i78-worklist-action-deletefindings-noop
note: POST …?action=deleteFindings, the action ADT discovery advertises as rel="http://www.sap.com/adt/atc/relations/actions/deleteFindings", answers 200 with a zero-byte body and leaves the worklist's findings unchanged afterwards. Server source shows CL_SATC_ADT_RES_WORKLIST->post returns immediately when the URI carries a worklist id, and the lcl_handler_delete_findings implementation in its CCIMP include is commented out in its entirety, so the advertised action is a no-op, not a cleanup.
capturedBy: Standalone python ADT probe (urllib + cookiejar) driven against the A4H sandbox appliance for issue #78's ATC completeness work. REAL wire recording, not synthetic.
requestHeadersNote: Only caller-supplied headers are listed. Authorization, Cookie, X-CSRF-Token and X-sap-adt-sessiontype were added by the probe's own session-management code and are deliberately not recorded.
requestUrlNote: Path and query only; the appliance host is deliberately not recorded, and neither is the sap-client parameter (001) the probe sent.
